sub_answers.text: Frans Dove represented the Gold Coast in early inter-colonial cricket matches against Nigeria and he founded that event series that became the region’s first international sporting events [d80508735s3p0]. The inter-colonial cricket competitions that began between the Gold Coast and Nigeria later extended to include Sierra Leone and The Gambia [d80508735s3p0]. Frans Dove personally financed the full outfitting of more than fifty players for these competitions and his home, Tutu House in Tudu, Accra, became a social and athletic hub that hosted major sporting events [d80508735s3p0].
